newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Sept 6.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto is likely to convene an extraordinary session of parliament as early as late September, dissolve the Lower House of parliament and decide a date for general elections, which will likely be set for late October.
Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp has decided to transfer directory inquiry service to subsidiaries and may increase its charge on inquiries.
Government panel's new proposals urge the government to make public business information disclosed by private firms subject to the condition of confidentiality.
Intel Japan will price its Pentium microprocessor in dollars from 1997. Japanese electronics firms hope dollar-denominated prices to eliminate exchange commission payments to banks.
Major paper makers expect lower profits in the year through March due to fall in prices and a rise in raw material costs as a result of the weaker yen.
